programme.title: Naturens största talanger
programme.desc: I naturen kan skenet också bedra. Oavsett om det sker under vatten eller ute i det fria, tack vare färgen på deras hud, päls eller fjädrar, kan djur från alla jordens alla hörn bli osynliga. Storleken är inget hinder för dessa vilda magiker, från små insekter till stora djur på de afrikanska slätterna.

programme.title: Djurens bostäder
programme.desc: Det är mäklarnas svar på vad som påverkar värdet på bostaden. Likadant i djurens värld. Men sparven som absolut ska bo nära vattnet riskerar att tidvattnet tar ägg och ungar. Och skraken som vill bo högt tvingar ungarna till vådliga språng.

programme.title: Italien med Stanley Tucci
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci besöker Umbrien, som har smeknamnet Italiens gröna hjärta. Med högst konsumtion av griskött per capita är Umbrien en köttälskares dröm. Från vildsvinsjakter till svart tryffelodlingar utforskar Stanley allt som Umbrien har att erbjuda.

programme.title: Ett enklare liv
programme.desc: Utrikeskorrespondenten Julius fick en dag nog av att rapportera från världens krigszoner. Han och flickvännen Kristin köpte en liten husbil och började utforska Kanadas vildmark. Tio år senare lever de ett väldigt annorlunda liv, ett liv de kämpar hårt för varje dag.

programme.title: Romerska härskare med Mary Beard
programme.desc: Historikern Mary Beard utforskar hur det verkligen var att vara romersk kejsare och tar oss med bakom palatsens väggar för att avslöja den dolda världen kring den romerska imperiala livsstilen. Genom sällsynta bevarade inskriptioner och artefakter från den kejserliga eran ger Mary oss sina unika insikter om kejsarnas liv. Och hon avslöjar även varför dessa mäktiga män ständigt var utsatta för mordhot i sina egna palats och hur absolut makt kom med absolut paranoia.

programme.title: Historiska mysterier
programme.desc: Cheopspyramiden har stått i 4500 år och är den enda av världens sju underverk som fortfarande finns kvar. Men gömmer den skatter och kammare som än inte har hittats? En samling historiker och arkeologer har samlats för att lösa historiens största gåtor.

programme.title: Den stora keramikkampen
programme.desc: En ny grupp keramiker kliver in i verkstaden. Första uppgiften blir att skapa en personlig födelsedagsservis, och dessutom väntar en utmaning där kannor utan handtag ska formas med stor precision.

programme.title: Nilen: flodernas flod
programme.desc: Nationalparken Murchison Falls har fått sitt namn av flodens vilda lopp. Här lever tusentals flodhästar, och det rika djurlivet fortsätter in i Sydsudan.

programme.title: Mellankrigstidens drömmar
programme.desc: I mellankrigstidens Europa lever folk i spillrorna av ett av världens mest omfattande världskrig, men med ett spirande hopp om en ny, förändrad värld. Europa är spelplatsen för kampen mellan de stora framväxande ideologierna, där fascismen, kommunismen, kapitalism och socialism slåss om övertaget. Samtidigt är det de stora framstegens tid, där industrialismen förändrat världen för alltid. En serie baserad på sanna berättelser från livet i en tid full av hopp och förtvivlan. Här följer vi ett antal människors livsöden, via deras autentiska dagböcker, brev och minnen.

programme.title: Ridsport: VM
programme.desc: Dressyrryttarna kliver in i den individuella delen genom att rida specialen på VM i Aachen. Dags för de första individuella medaljerna alltså, och dags för startfältet att bantas ordentligt inför küren. Kommentator: AnnaMaria Fredholm och Mats Eriksson.

programme.title: Historier från Norge runt
programme.desc: Det har inte varit kalvar på Røst i Lofoten sedan 1972, så när Kari-Annes kvigor väntar tillökning är spänningen stor bland grannarna. Och när så kalvarna Ester och Per äntligen släpps ut på grönbete för första gången är glädjen stor. (Norge, 2020)

programme.title: Fiskestugan
programme.desc: Tvillingarna och sportfiskeentusiasterna Ásmundur och Gunnar tar oss med på fisketur till olika platser runt omkring på Island. I seriens första avsnitt väntar insjöfiske i Þingvallavatn, där bröderna hoppas få istidsöring på kroken.

programme.title: Jakten på jordens resurser
programme.desc: Jakten på guld har förändrat både landskap och samhällen. Men i takt med att de naturliga guldreserverna sinar växer intresset för guldutvinning till havs och amatörguldgrävare fortsätter att göra oväntade fynd. Vi undersöker varför guldet fortfarande driver oss att tänja på gränserna och utforska nya horisonter.

programme.title: På resa med Bachstad: Japan
programme.desc: Resan går till Kyoto där Rune glömmer att sätta på kameran, och 83-årige Yoneda-san vänder upp och ner på allt. Därefter går resan till det jordbävningsdrabbade Kobe.

programme.title: Historiska mysterier
programme.desc: I århundraden har kungar, sultaner, lärda och skattjägare sökt efter den heliga graalen - Jesus bägare från den sista måltiden. Men kan den ha bevarats i 2000 år, och var finns den i så fall?

programme.title: Fråga Lund
programme.desc: Programledaren Robin tar hjälp av rymdfysikern Gabriella för att en gång för alla reda ut hur mycket det stänker när män står upp och kissar. Psykologiforskaren Armita berättar varför det är så hemskt att bli uttråkad och kemisten Ulf bjuder på en rejäl smäll. Medverkande: Robin Paulsson, Ulf Ellervik, Gunnar Wetterberg, Jessica Abbott, Armita Golkar och Henrik Widegren.

programme.title: Atlantens mörka vatten
programme.desc: Under vintern är vattnet i Nordatlanten extra förrädiskt. Enorma stormar kan blossa upp när som helst. Men som undervattenskameramannen Ken O’Sullivan upptäcker är dessa stormar en viktig källa till fertilitet i havet. Del 1 av 3.

programme.title: Övergivna byggnader
programme.desc: En förfallen idrottsarena i Litauen som en gång stod värd för en osannolik match under kalla kriget. En industrirelik i England präglad av striden mellan fackrörelsen och Margaret Thatcher, och ett gotiskt torn i Memphis som lockade rock’n’roll-eliten. Alla berättar de historier om storslagna planer som gick om intet.

programme.title: Asiens gröna öar
programme.desc: Borneo, Java, Nya Guinea, Sulawesi - övärlden mellan det asiatiska fastlandet och Australien är artrikast i hela världen, såväl på land som i vattnet. Här lever paradisfåglarna, den klättrande kängurun och världens mest sällsynta noshörning.

programme.title: Djurens bostäder
programme.desc: Det är mäklarnas svar på vad som påverkar värdet på bostaden. Likadant i djurens värld. Men sparven som absolut ska bo nära vattnet riskerar att tidvattnet tar ägg och ungar. Och skraken som vill bo högt tvingar ungarna till vådliga språng.

programme.title: Så byggdes Sverige
programme.desc: Resan börjar i Kortedala i Göteborg där Gert Wingårdh och Mark Isitt förundras över hur den svenska förorten inspirerar stadsbyggande över hela världen. Petra Mede bekantar sig med det svenska standardköket och Gert beger sig till Limhamns kalkbrott i Malmö, där betongindustrin blir en maktfaktor för svenskt bostadsbyggande. Resan mynnar ut i Miljonprogrammet och det utskällda Skärholmen som invigs 1968. Mark hyllar tunnelbanan och Gert träffar Malmös stadsarkitekt i Rosengård för att resonera om huruvida förortens framtid är lika ljus som den en gång var.

programme.title: Ridsport: VM
programme.desc: Efter att ha klarat av dressyrdelen är det nu dags för fälttävlansryttarna att ge sig ut på den största kraftmätningen, nämligen terrängritten. VM i Aachen bjuder på spektakulär bansträckning och vidunderlig natur. Kommentatorer: AnnaMaria Fredholm och Lars Christensson.

programme.title: Wiener Philharmoniker, Christian Thielemann, Elīna Garanča - Brahms, Bruckner

programme.title: Electronic Vibrations - A sound changes the world
programme.desc: Whether techno or hip-hop – electronic music is nowadays the driving force of pop culture. We have almost forgotten that its origins lie in the WDR’s electronic studio, which made Cologne to one of the centres of the avant-garde during the post-war years. This is the story of how a room full of strange devices would become a cabinet of curiosities, the vibrations of which sent the whole world in a state of ecstasy. From the beginnings directly after the Second World War in Paris with Pierre Schaeffer’s ‘musique concrète’, the film focuses on Stockhausen and goes on to Kraftwerk, from Jean-Michel Jarre and the IRCAM studio right up to Detroit to the beginnings of techno.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control

programme.title: Dietrich Fischer-Dieskau: Last Words
programme.desc: The great German baritone Dietrich Fischer-Dieskau was greatly admired for his interpretive insight, note-perfect control of the tonal qualities, and shadings of color in his voice, for exceptional rhythmic sense and impeccable diction. His reputation as a lieder singer is so high – he had a repertoire of more than 3.000 songs – that it is easy to forget his extensive list of operatic roles. In this conversation Fischer-Dieskau reveals for the last time on camera the secrets of his outstanding career. His ‘Last Words’ provide a deep insight into the extraordinary artistic life of one of the most famous and prolific lieder singers of our time. Dietrich Fischer-Dieskau died in May 2012 at the age of 86.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control

programme.title: Bruckner: Symphony No.9 - Sergiu Celibidache, Münchner Philharmoniker
programme.desc: In his late years, Sergiu Celibidache (1912-1996) focused his attention on one particular composer: Anton Bruckner. In March 1991 he rehearsed Bruckner´s Ninth in unusually long and intense sessions with the Munich Philharmonics. Using unpublished footage, this film shows the individual stages of this tantalizing process of a seemingly familiar piece being rediscovered. Again and again Celibidache interrupts the musicians to communicate his sharply articulated thoughts.

programme.desc: Martorell near the Mediterranean city of Barcelona is the home of Seat’s largest production plant. Vehicles have been produced here since 1950. Today, half a million cars per year are produced on an area of almost three million square meters. The plant is considered to be one of the most advanced in Europe. 14,000 employees, industry 4.0, human-machine collaboration and an army of over 2,000 robots are deployed here. Made in Spain takes a look behind the scenes of Seat.

programme.title: Car People
programme.desc: Red deserts, mystical sounds and endless spaces: To travel the Australian outback by car has always been a dream for the 25 year old student Lena Kwasow. As a passionate driver and committed Mini fan she wants to do a 10-day trip in a Mini through the Northern Territory, from Alice Springs to Ayers Rock. Along the way she encounters a fascinating fauna and stunning nature.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The story of the Wankel rotary engine starts with a vision. Felix Wankel wants to build a new kind of combustion engine. He succeeds in 1957, when his engine worked for the very first time. Later on Audi-NSU uses the engine in some of their production cars like the Ro 80. At the End of the 1960s Mercedes actually uses the rotary engine in a sports car: the legendary Mercedes C111.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: This is AMG's vision of an electric future: The Concept AMG GT XX delivers an unbelievable 1,360 horsepower and charges faster than you can say “range anxiety.” We were there for the spectacular world premiere. And: This racer looks like it came straight out of a retro film – but it’s actu-ally the brand-new top model from Morgan. We reveal five exciting facts about this British masterpiece.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Jaguar XF-S is supposed to put pressure on BMW, Audi and co. in the business class segment. With V6 power, 380 HP output and all-wheel drive it wants to teach the German top dogs the true meaning of the word fear. Volvo takes a different approach. The S90 is captivating due to its Scandinavian design and economical four-cylinder engines.

programme.title: Fastzone 2025
programme.desc: This show brings you the best mix of national and international powersports from around the world.

programme.title: DTM 2025
programme.desc: The Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM) thrills with close GT3 racing, featuring top drivers and teams competing on iconic circuits across Germany and Europe. High-octane motorsport at its finest.

programme.title: All Wheel Drive Safari Challenge 2025
programme.desc: The AWDC is a british offorad event where drivers have to tackle tight and twisty roads filled with mud und gravel

programme.title: Australian Drag Racing Championship 2024
programme.desc: The Australian Drag Racing Championship is a regional motorsport series for top fuel dragsters that exceed speeds of roughly 300 mp/h in under 5 seconds

programme.title: FIM Quadcross World Championship 2026
programme.desc: The FIM QuadCross World Championship (formerly EMX Quad European Championship) is the premier international competition for quad bike motocross.

programme.title: Monster Jam Championship 2025
programme.desc: Monster Jam is an American monster truck series where drivers have to perform stunts and race against each other

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad 2025
programme.desc: The Icelandic Formula Off-Road is one of the most extreme racing series in the world and demands everything from the teams and their specially built vehicles. Nearly vertical cliffs have to be climbed, demanding time challenges have to be solved or spectacular aquaplaning stunts have to be performed.

programme.title: US Pro Pulling 2023
programme.desc: Tractor pulling is a competitive motorsport where modified tractors or trucks pull a heavy sled along a specified distance within a track. The sport is known for its powerful machines and intense competition.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Convertibles with plenty of power. Porsche 911 Targa - the cult classic par excellence! Extreme lightweight Construction. The Lotus Seven Twin Cam SS - more race - than road car. This car demands the whole man. The 1930 Bentley Blower. And Sunbeam Tiger. A large V8 heart beats In this dainty English Roadster.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: It is regarded as the most successful luxury sedan in the world — a synonym for comfort and opulence — and it sets the benchmark when it comes to technology and safety: the Mercedes S-Class. But why is that? What makes this vehicle so special and sets it apart from all others? We drive every generation, from the 450 SEL 6.9 to the current S 580 e, and explore the fascination behind each model.

programme.title: Sport doc: Keisari Beckenbauer
programme.desc: Franz Beckenbaueria pidetään Saksan kaikkien aikojen parhaana jalkapalloilijana ja yhtenä maailman parhaista. Hän toi maalleen maailmanmestaruuden ensin pelaajana, sitten valmentajan roolissa. Lisäksi hän oli ratkaisevassa asemassa, kun MM-kisat 2006 saatiin Saksaan. Tähän hattutemppuun ei ole kukaan muu pystynyt. Hän oli myös esikuva ja modernin miehen malli sodanjälkeisessä Saksassa.

programme.title: Sport Doc: The Boys on the Bus
programme.desc: Dokumentissa seurataan Edmonton Oilersia jäällä ja sen ulkopuolella kaudella 1986 - 1987 matkalla kohti kolmatta NHL-mestaruutta. Mukana ovat myös suomalaispelaajat Jari Kurri, Esa Tikkanen ja Raimo Summanen.

programme.title: Vaarallisimmat saalistajat
programme.desc: Kärpät, vuorisudet, sinirengasmustekalat ja muut pienet ja vaaralliset eläimet pystyvät saalistamaan monta kertaa itseänsä suurempia eläimiä.

programme.title: Maailman vaarallisimmat hait
programme.desc: Maailman vaarallisimmat hait esittelee useita hailajeja, kuten tiikerihain, viiksihain ja kaikkien haiden kuninkaan eli valtavan valkohain. Näemme, miten hait saalistavat ja millaista niiden arki on.

programme.title: Villin Intian salaisuudet
programme.desc: Intia on poikkeuksellisen monimuotoinen maa. Viideososa maailman väestöstä jakaa sen villin luonnon kanssa. Katsojat pääsevät ihailemaan ääripäiden maata. Uskaltaudumme 6 400 metrin korkeuteen Himalajan vuorille, sulavan jään muodostaman Brahmaputra-joen lähteille. Tapaamme uhanalaisen intiansarvikuonon ja tutustumme vaarallisiin puhveleihin.

programme.title: Vaarallisimmat saalistajat
programme.desc: Gepardi, sekunnin kymmenesosassa saaliinsa nielevä taivaantähystäjä ja myrkyllinen mustamamba kuuluvat luonnon vikkelämpiin tappajiin.

programme.title: Vaarallisimmat saalistajat
programme.desc: Kärpät, vuorisudet, sinirengasmustekalat ja muut pienet ja vaaralliset eläimet pystyvät saalistamaan monta kertaa itseänsä suurempia eläimiä.

programme.title: Tahiti Pearl Regatta
programme.desc: To organize a yearly sailing party in the Leeward Islands of French Polynesia: that was the dream of the newly born Raiatea Regatta Association. Since then, the “TPR” has become the biggest sailing and festive regatta of the Pacific islands and a truly international nautical event.Over the years, the TPR has become the most “beautifun” regatta of the Pacific island, attracting international crews each year in search of an extraordinary experience. In a warm and authentic atmosphere, the TPR takes place in lagoons with captivating colours, festive stops on islands or motu (islets along the coral reef) and with the sound of the Polynesian winds.The itinerary changes each year, discovering new islands of Raiatea, but what never changes is the fun and beautiful scenery characteristic of this unique regatta.

programme.title: VOR Identity
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race visits 10 cities around the world making it the ultimate test for sailors around the world. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s Big Three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.However, to truly understand the race, it is better to think about the athletes who take part of it. Meet the teams and the superstars in Alicante on the eve of their quest to the Volvo Ocean Race. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win.Map the racecourse, get the latest intel on the boats and the tech and above all, find out what really moves the action of heroes from modern day offshore sailing. Watch it now, on Nautical Channel and become part of this sailing frenzy.

programme.title: Reaching Reality
programme.desc: ORIGIN: From under the Golden Gate Bridge down to the Santa Cruz Islands the three friends and their little boat are now heading south. However bad weather is on the horizon and signs that the film and the filmmaker are already thinking about abandoning ship are starting to leak through. After a long night of sea sickness, it’s time to face reality and see who’s going to stick around and who’s going to go.

programme.title: Reaching Reality
programme.desc: REALITY: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: We have arrived at the beautiful islands of Cres and Lošinj where we will explore amazing places and learn how to cook buzara (Buzara is Croatian way of cooking mussels with only few simple ingredients. This easy mussels recipe is popular along the Dalmatian coast). We will also sail over to Istria and the magical islands of Brijuni.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: (A new season of Sail-Ho! Croatia brings you the most fascinating destinations on the Croatian coast. Breathtaking landscapes, untouched nature, exquisite cuisine, no wonder Croatia is by many considered to be a true Hedonist Paradise.) We start at the southernmost part of the Croatian Coast - the old city of Dubrovnik. We will reveal you some secrets and show you some interesting attractions. After Dubrovnik, we set our sail towards mystical island of Lastovo that was until recently a navy stronghold.

programme.title: Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Big wave surfer Andrew Cotton, a plumber and father of two from Devon, hit the headlines in 2014 when it was rumoured that he had surfed the world’s biggest wave, estimated at 80ft. In this one-off 30-minute documentary, Andrew and his team of surfers, sailors and adventurers put everything on hold as they secretly chase a wave that emerges only a handful of times each year, giving only hours of warning.Taking a boat eight miles off the coast of Ireland, the team battle the extreme cold and fierce weather conditions, whilst mapping the ocean’s swell, in order to try to catch one almighty ride. Far from home and with the days getting shorter, frustration sets in, as the window of opportunity gets smaller. With a young family at home, Andrew must balance the normality of the school run, before boarding a plane alone to face one of earth’s deadliest monsters.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: We are in stage three of the Canoe Slalom World Cup, and this time we will be competing on the water of Ljubljana, in Tacen. The racing conditions are perfect and we are focused on the final: men will be competing in C1 and women in K1. Matej Benus who was leading the standings in the men's category will not be competing in the final, so Benjamin Savsek has a chance to step up in the podium. Relive the best moments of the third stage of the 2018 Canoe Slalom World Cup in Tacen.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: We are in Markkleeberg, Germany, for round four of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. This is the third time this venue hosts a World Cup, and 183 athletes from 26 countries have enrolled, competing for points across the five-race World Cup. As we are a month away from the olympic qualifiers and World Championships in Spain, we are ready for a sharp end of the 2019 international racing season. Discover the best moments in Markkleeberg on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Inside Kiel - Sailing Capital and more
programme.desc: Kiel is the nautical epicentre of Germany, and the proud host of the world's biggest sailing event, the Kieler Woche. From learning how to sail a Formula18 catamaran to exploring local kitesurf spots and shipyards, Nautical Channel host Lucia Metzbauer will be there, diving into the local nautical scene and finding out why there are so many young sailors in Kiel.Join her in Kieler Woche, one of the largest sailing events in the world. With regattas sailing at the highest level and an unbeatable class diversity, entertainment is secured as we learn everything about this German event that drives the attention of sailors worldwide.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Jet Ski World Series
programme.desc: Put your helmets on because we are getting started with the Jet Ski World Series! Delivering whooping speeds of 100km/hr in under 3.8 seconds and with 500 horsepower, riders need to be sharp to turn 30 degrees at 140 km/h, putting the 'Jet' in Jet Ski. Wearing no protective body, grappling with the waves and fighting out with gravity, the riders that dare challenge this competition are some of the most corageous athletes in the world. Are you going to miss out? Tune up to the latest edition of the Jet Ski World Series!

programme.title: Reaching Reality
programme.desc: ORIGIN: From under the Golden Gate Bridge down to the Santa Cruz Islands the three friends and their little boat are now heading south. However bad weather is on the horizon and signs that the film and the filmmaker are already thinking about abandoning ship are starting to leak through. After a long night of sea sickness, it’s time to face reality and see who’s going to stick around and who’s going to go.

programme.title: Reaching Reality
programme.desc: REALITY: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Big wave surfer Andrew Cotton, a plumber and father of two from Devon, hit the headlines in 2014 when it was rumoured that he had surfed the world’s biggest wave, estimated at 80ft. In this one-off 30-minute documentary, Andrew and his team of surfers, sailors and adventurers put everything on hold as they secretly chase a wave that emerges only a handful of times each year, giving only hours of warning.Taking a boat eight miles off the coast of Ireland, the team battle the extreme cold and fierce weather conditions, whilst mapping the ocean’s swell, in order to try to catch one almighty ride. Far from home and with the days getting shorter, frustration sets in, as the window of opportunity gets smaller. With a young family at home, Andrew must balance the normality of the school run, before boarding a plane alone to face one of earth’s deadliest monsters.

programme.title: Sail-Ho

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Inside Kiel - Sailing Capital and more
programme.desc: Kiel is the nautical epicentre of Germany, and the proud host of the world's biggest sailing event, the Kieler Woche. From learning how to sail a Formula18 catamaran to exploring local kitesurf spots and shipyards, Nautical Channel host Lucia Metzbauer will be there, diving into the local nautical scene and finding out why there are so many young sailors in Kiel.Join her in Kieler Woche, one of the largest sailing events in the world. With regattas sailing at the highest level and an unbeatable class diversity, entertainment is secured as we learn everything about this German event that drives the attention of sailors worldwide.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: We are in stage three of the Canoe Slalom World Cup, and this time we will be competing on the water of Ljubljana, in Tacen. The racing conditions are perfect and we are focused on the final: men will be competing in C1 and women in K1. Matej Benus who was leading the standings in the men's category will not be competing in the final, so Benjamin Savsek has a chance to step up in the podium. Relive the best moments of the third stage of the 2018 Canoe Slalom World Cup in Tacen.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: We are in Markkleeberg, Germany, for round four of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. This is the third time this venue hosts a World Cup, and 183 athletes from 26 countries have enrolled, competing for points across the five-race World Cup. As we are a month away from the olympic qualifiers and World Championships in Spain, we are ready for a sharp end of the 2019 international racing season. Discover the best moments in Markkleeberg on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Tahiti Pearl Regatta
programme.desc: To organize a yearly sailing party in the Leeward Islands of French Polynesia: that was the dream of the newly born Raiatea Regatta Association. Since then, the “TPR” has become the biggest sailing and festive regatta of the Pacific islands and a truly international nautical event.Over the years, the TPR has become the most “beautifun” regatta of the Pacific island, attracting international crews each year in search of an extraordinary experience. In a warm and authentic atmosphere, the TPR takes place in lagoons with captivating colours, festive stops on islands or motu (islets along the coral reef) and with the sound of the Polynesian winds.The itinerary changes each year, discovering new islands of Raiatea, but what never changes is the fun and beautiful scenery characteristic of this unique regatta.

programme.title: VOR Identity
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race visits 10 cities around the world making it the ultimate test for sailors around the world. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s Big Three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.However, to truly understand the race, it is better to think about the athletes who take part of it. Meet the teams and the superstars in Alicante on the eve of their quest to the Volvo Ocean Race. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win.Map the racecourse, get the latest intel on the boats and the tech and above all, find out what really moves the action of heroes from modern day offshore sailing. Watch it now, on Nautical Channel and become part of this sailing frenzy.

programme.title: Wild Surf
programme.desc: In this episode of Wild Surf, we’re in the Mentawai islands in Indonesia for ‘Morning Glory’, a documentary featuring eight French surfers as they head to the islands in search of the perfect surf. Featuring surfers Marc Lacomare, Benjamin Sanchis, Alain Riou, Naum Ildefonse, Romain Cloitre, Jason Aparicio and Charly Martin, Morning Glory takes us on a journey through some of the best waves in the islands. From the infamous Greenbush to the little known Roxy, this is the surfing trip of a lifetime.

programme.title: Wild Surf
programme.desc: A packed episode for you, with footage from the Nixon Surf Challenge, the story of MS surfboards and ‘Away’ - an amazing short documentary about three women who surf in New York City. The Nixon surf challenge has been going on for a decade now. The event has grown from a casual get together of befriended riders, into the annual trip it is today.

programme.title: Who is Vilayta
programme.desc: WHO IS VILAYTA is a short biographical documentary that reveals the nature of Vilayta, one of the pioneers of big wave surfing on the Canary Islands, a man who has a special link to the ocean and that Germán Pinelo captures perfectly in this impressive work. The film is a formidable combination of passion, dreams, friendship, craziness and gentleness, a work that deepens the character beyond the figure of the surfer. An artful motion picture that breaks myth and makes legends.

programme.desc: Anchored in Paradise

programme.title: The Barrel
programme.desc: Since the first wave was ridden, surfers have shared stories and experiences to try to explain the wonders inside the waves they ride.Professional and amateur surfers, photographers and videographers around the world have the possibility to display their passion: Barrel surfing. This term is used by surfers to describe riding well inside the curve of a finely shaped breaking wave, for many described as magical.The Barrel is all about surfer’s skills, creativity and love for adventure as they look for the best waves for tube riding. Get inside the barrel of the wave, with Nautical Channel.

As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: Who is Vilayta
programme.desc: WHO IS VILAYTA is a short biographical documentary that reveals the nature of Vilayta, one of the pioneers of big wave surfing on the Canary Islands, a man who has a special link to the ocean and that Germán Pinelo captures perfectly in this impressive work. The film is a formidable combination of passion, dreams, friendship, craziness and gentleness, a work that deepens the character beyond the figure of the surfer. An artful motion picture that breaks myth and makes legends.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise
programme.desc: Anchored in Paradise

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Inside Kiel - Sailing Capital and more
programme.desc: Kiel is the nautical epicentre of Germany, and the proud host of the world's biggest sailing event, the Kieler Woche. From learning how to sail a Formula18 catamaran to exploring local kitesurf spots and shipyards, Nautical Channel host Lucia Metzbauer will be there, diving into the local nautical scene and finding out why there are so many young sailors in Kiel.Join her in Kieler Woche, one of the largest sailing events in the world. With regattas sailing at the highest level and an unbeatable class diversity, entertainment is secured as we learn everything about this German event that drives the attention of sailors worldwide.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Tahiti Pearl Regatta
programme.desc: To organize a yearly sailing party in the Leeward Islands of French Polynesia: that was the dream of the newly born Raiatea Regatta Association. Since then, the “TPR” has become the biggest sailing and festive regatta of the Pacific islands and a truly international nautical event.Over the years, the TPR has become the most “beautifun” regatta of the Pacific island, attracting international crews each year in search of an extraordinary experience. In a warm and authentic atmosphere, the TPR takes place in lagoons with captivating colours, festive stops on islands or motu (islets along the coral reef) and with the sound of the Polynesian winds.The itinerary changes each year, discovering new islands of Raiatea, but what never changes is the fun and beautiful scenery characteristic of this unique regatta.

programme.title: VOR Identity
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race visits 10 cities around the world making it the ultimate test for sailors around the world. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s Big Three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.However, to truly understand the race, it is better to think about the athletes who take part of it. Meet the teams and the superstars in Alicante on the eve of their quest to the Volvo Ocean Race. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win.Map the racecourse, get the latest intel on the boats and the tech and above all, find out what really moves the action of heroes from modern day offshore sailing. Watch it now, on Nautical Channel and become part of this sailing frenzy.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: We are in stage three of the Canoe Slalom World Cup, and this time we will be competing on the water of Ljubljana, in Tacen. The racing conditions are perfect and we are focused on the final: men will be competing in C1 and women in K1. Matej Benus who was leading the standings in the men's category will not be competing in the final, so Benjamin Savsek has a chance to step up in the podium. Relive the best moments of the third stage of the 2018 Canoe Slalom World Cup in Tacen.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: We are in Markkleeberg, Germany, for round four of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. This is the third time this venue hosts a World Cup, and 183 athletes from 26 countries have enrolled, competing for points across the five-race World Cup. As we are a month away from the olympic qualifiers and World Championships in Spain, we are ready for a sharp end of the 2019 international racing season. Discover the best moments in Markkleeberg on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: We have arrived at the beautiful islands of Cres and Lošinj where we will explore amazing places and learn how to cook buzara (Buzara is Croatian way of cooking mussels with only few simple ingredients. This easy mussels recipe is popular along the Dalmatian coast). We will also sail over to Istria and the magical islands of Brijuni.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: (A new season of Sail-Ho! Croatia brings you the most fascinating destinations on the Croatian coast. Breathtaking landscapes, untouched nature, exquisite cuisine, no wonder Croatia is by many considered to be a true Hedonist Paradise.) We start at the southernmost part of the Croatian Coast - the old city of Dubrovnik. We will reveal you some secrets and show you some interesting attractions. After Dubrovnik, we set our sail towards mystical island of Lastovo that was until recently a navy stronghold.

programme.title: Reaching Reality
programme.desc: ORIGIN: From under the Golden Gate Bridge down to the Santa Cruz Islands the three friends and their little boat are now heading south. However bad weather is on the horizon and signs that the film and the filmmaker are already thinking about abandoning ship are starting to leak through. After a long night of sea sickness, it’s time to face reality and see who’s going to stick around and who’s going to go.

Tässä jaksossa käydään tunnetiloja läpi liikkeen kautta yhdistellen eri aisteja ja mielikuvia omaan kehoon. Tervetuloa mukaan. Harjoitukset sopivat kaikille katsojille.

programme.title: Liikettä ja vahvistusta koko keholle: selän hyvinvointi
programme.desc: Tuokiossa keskitytään erityisesti selkärangan eri liikesuuntien ylläpitämiseen ja liikelaajuuden lisääntymiseen. Vahvistetaan erityisesti reisiä, pakaralihasta ja keskivartalon lihaksia, jotka tukevat seisoma-asentoa, kävelyä sekä esimerkiksi seisomaannousua.

programme.title: Yhteislauluhetki
programme.desc: Kansanmuusikko Heikki Savola toimii esilaulajana. Luvassa on rakastettuja klassikkoja. Tule mukaan laulamaan! Lauluina Musta rudolf, Kalastaja-eemelin valssi, Merimieslaulu, Rempallaan, Tulipunaruusut, Kultainen nuoruus, Kotiseutuni, Tunturin juurella, On armas mulle allon tie, Kertokaa se hänelle, Käymme yhdessä ain, Koskaan et muuttua saa.

programme.title: Turvallisesti netissä - Huijausviestit
programme.desc: Ohjelmasarjassa kerromme internetin turvallisesta käytöstä ja opimme siitä yhdessä vieraiden kokemuksien kautta. Tässä jaksossa opimme tunnistamaan erilaisia huijausviestejä, joita rikolliset käyttävät tietojenkalasteluun ja muihin petoksiin. Ohjelman juontajana ja ilmiöistä kertomassa on tietoturva-asiantuntija Samuli Könönen Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto Traficomin Kyberturvallisuuskeskuksesta. Tervetuloa oppimaan arjen tietoturvasta.

programme.title: Hengähdyshetki - Liiketerapia
programme.desc: Kehon tarpeiden kuuntelu on tärkeää jokapäiväisessä elämässä. Tässä hengähdyshetkessä pääset antamaan täyden huomion keholle ja tehdä juuri niitä asioita ja liikkeitä, joita keho tänään kaipaa. Tanssi-liiketerapian avulla pystyt vahvistamaan kehon ja mielen yhteyttä, sekä kehon hahmotusta ja kehotietoisuutta. Hetken voi toteuttaa itselle sopivassa asennossa, kuunnellen omia tarpeita. Kehomme ja mielemme ansaitsevat huolenpitoa. Ota hetki vain itsellesi ja tule mukaan rauhoittumaan liikkeen avulla.

programme.title: Linea Verde Estate
programme.desc: interpreti dei Persiani di Eschilo - l'incontro dei nostri conduttori, pronti per una nuova avventura. Le antiche cave di pietra utilizzate per estrarre il materiale da costruzione, i reperti storici, lo sfondo di una rigogliosa flora mediterranea: la magia del Parco archeologico della Neapolis, uno dei più importanti della Sicilia. La Piazza del Duomo, la Basilica di Santa Lucia al Sepolcro, la storia e la fuga del Caravaggio: nella parte più antica della città, alla scoperta dei tesori nascosti dell'isola di Ortigia. Da quelle culinarie a quelle legate al benessere e alla cosmesi: con un produttore di limoni, le infinite declinazioni di un frutto simbolo della tradizione Mediterranea. Oltre 200 ettari adibiti ad agrumeti e vigneti: nell'antico Feudo della Targia, in un'azienda agricola a conduzione familiare, il recupero dei vitigni. Il buono che fa bene perché rende sereni: in un laboratorio di pasticceria fondato nel 1952, la secolare arte della produzione dei mitici cannoli siciliani. Gran finale: circondati dalla storia, nel Teatro Greco di Siracusa, le emozioni condivise di un viaggio giunto al termine. La puntata è stata realizzata in convenzione con la Regione Sicilia.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Da ein Mordopfer mit einem tödlichen Virus infiziert war, müssen Sara und Greg isoliert werden.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Der Chemielehrer Chet Messner stürzt brennend aus dem Unterrichtsraum auf den Flur und stirbt vor den Augen der Schüler. Zunächst sieht alles nach einem Unfall aus. Doch in der Gerichtsmedizin zeigt sich, dass Messner nicht an den Folgen der Verbrennung, sondern an einer Zyanidvergiftung gestorben ist. Bei der Durchsuchung im Haus des Toten finden die Ermittler einen Altar des Wicca-Kultes. Kurze Zeit später wird ein Schüler ermordet aufgefunden.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Morgan überredet Sara und Finn zu einem gemeinsamen Erholungswochenende in Reno, wo die drei so richtig entspannen wollen. Doch sehr weit kommen sie nicht. In der Nähe von Larkston beginnt Finns Auto zu streiken. Sie bekommen Hilfe vom smarten Darryl, der sie in die Stadt mitnimmt. Sie werden wohl in der Stadt übernachten müssen. Darryl beginnt heftig mit Finn zu flirten. Doch als Finn mitbekommt, dass Darryl vergeben ist, weist sie ihn zurück. Da zückt Darryl ein Messer und bedroht Finn.

programme.title: Deutschland am Morgen
programme.desc: Dein Morgen, dein Rhythmus: Deutschland am Morgen von RTL und ntv ist der tägliche Begleiter für alle, die bestens informiert und gut unterhalten in den Tag starten wollen. Von 6 bis 9 Uhr liefert das Nachrichtenmagazin die wichtigsten Themen und ordnet sie verständlich ein. Ob Politik, Wirtschaft, Sport oder Service: Feste Rubriken und spannende Talks sorgen für den richtigen Takt am Morgen.

programme.title: Gute Zeiten, schlechte Zeiten
programme.desc: Yvonne unterstützt Michi in einer schwierigen Phase, was eine Annäherung ermöglichen könnte. Nina akzeptiert Hilfe, muss dafür jedoch Opfer bringen. Katrin warnt Gerner vor einer neuen Bekanntschaft, doch er bleibt unbesorgt.

programme.title: Unter uns
programme.desc: Ute ist schockiert über die düsteren Aussichten für die Schillerallee, doch sie muss sich der Herausforderung nicht allein stellen. Baris genießt die Nähe zu Larissa, die ihm hilft, eine besondere Erinnerung aufleben zu lassen, bis ein verborgenes Geheimnis ihre Beziehung belastet. Esma setzt alles daran, ihre Konditorei wieder in Schwung zu bringen, doch ihre ambitionierten Pläne sorgen nicht bei allen für Begeisterung.

programme.title: Ulrich Wetzel - Das Strafgericht
programme.desc: Britta Noack möchte das Haus ihres Cousins Torben Daab zu einem niedrigen Preis erwerben, doch er bleibt stur. Die Lage eskaliert, als ein Molotowcocktail in Brittas Garten geworfen wird. Torben ist jedoch nicht der einzige Verdächtige.

programme.title: Barbara Salesch - Das Strafgericht
programme.desc: Marlies Ernst (59) soll ihre Rivalin Karin Ludwig (45) mit einer Harke verletzt haben - doch im jahrelangen Streit der Nachbarinnen ist kaum klar, wer Opfer und wer Täter ist. Ein Zeuge belastet Marlies, während ihre Enkelin ihr ein Alibi gibt. Als dann neue Hinweise und mysteriöse Funde auftauchen, wird das Netz aus Verdächtigungen noch dichter. Wer ist der wahre Täter in diesem eskalierten Nachbarschaftskrieg?

programme.title: Punkt 12 - Das RTL-Mittagsjournal
programme.desc: Aktuelle Informationen, Servicethemen, jede Menge Lifestyle und das Neueste aus der Welt der Prominenten - das ist nur die eine Seite von Punkt 12. Darüber hinaus gibt es täglich spannende und ausführliche Reportagen und Mini-Dokus, die je nach Blickwinkel verblüffende, schrille oder schockierende Einblicke in den Alltag der Deutschen geben.

programme.title: Barbara Salesch - Das Strafgericht
programme.desc: Die Erotik-Streamerin Annika Johl soll die Steckdose ihrer Nachbarin manipuliert haben, um ihren Stromklau zu vertuschen. Doch im Laufe der Verhandlung geraten auch der Vermieter Oliver Krautmacher und Rosis Sohn Christian unter Verdacht.

programme.title: Ulrich Wetzel - Das Strafgericht
programme.desc: Ruth Fechter wird beschuldigt, den Oldtimer ihres Jugendschwarmes Philipp Wolf gestohlen und zu Schrott gefahren zu haben. Auch die Eheringe des Paares sind verschwunden. Doch wer steckt wirklich hinter den Sabotageakten gegen die Hochzeit?

programme.title: Ulrich Wetzel - Das Jugendgericht
programme.desc: Konrad Henning gibt zu, einen Handyshop ausgeraubt zu haben. Doch sein Motiv, einen Kick gesucht zu haben, glaubt ihm keiner. Seine Mutter ist überzeugt, dass jemand ihren braven Privatschüler-Sohn angestiftet hat. Doch wieso sollte ein Jugendlicher aus gutem Haus einen Handyshop ausrauben? Hat Konrads unbekannte Ex-Freundin, zu der seine Mutter ihm den Kontakt verboten hat, vielleicht irgendetwas damit zu tun?

programme.title: Unter uns
programme.desc: Irene versucht, den Abriss ihres Hauses zu verhindern und motiviert ihr Umfeld. Baris ist von Larissas Lügen verletzt, während Esma sich in die Arbeit stürzt, um ihre Konditorei zu retten, doch auch sie erhält die Abrissnachricht.

programme.title: Explosiv - Das Magazin
programme.desc: Aktuell, mitreißend und gefährlich ehrlich - das ist Deutschlands beliebtestes tägliches Boulevard-Magazin. Explosiv präsentiert die Geschichten, die Deutschland bewegen und regelmäßig für öffentliche Diskussionen sorgen. Das RTL-Magazin knüpft immer dort an, wo die Geschichten der Menschen hinter den News beginnen und beweist, dass Boulevard deutlich mehr ist als nur Sensationsjournalismus.

programme.title: Exclusiv - Das Starmagazin
programme.desc: Wo ein roter Teppich ausgerollt wird, ist Exclusiv nicht weit. Täglich liefert Deutschlands erfolgreichstes Starmagazin die aktuellsten Promi-News, verrät die heißesten Gerüchte und gibt Einblicke in das Leben der angesagtesten Celebrities dieser Welt. programme.title: Madame Web
programme.desc: Cassandra Cassie Webb arbeitet im New Yorker Stadtteil Manhattan als Sanitäterin. Im Krankenwagen gehört das Retten von Menschen also zu ihrem Alltag. Doch ein unerwartetes Ereignis lässt sie von einer rein menschlichen Heldin zur Superheldin reifen: Sie erlangt eine Fähigkeit, die sie offenbar in die Zukunft sehen lässt. Dadurch kann sie Ereignisse, die schlecht für sie ausgehen, einfach noch einmal neu in Angriff nehmen. Diese mal verwirrende und mal nützliche Gabe stellt Cassies Leben gewaltig auf den Kopf. Zeit zum Durchatmen hat sie aber ohnehin nicht, denn prompt tritt ein Bösewicht im Spider-Man-Anzug auf den Plan, der mit allen Wasser gewaschen ist. Doch welches Ziel verfolgt dieser Ezekiel Sims und was hat das mit den drei jungen Frauen Julia Carpenter, Anya Corazon und Mattie Franklin zu tun, die ebenfalls in die Sache hineingezogen werden? Nur eins ist klar: Wenn die drei eine Zukunft haben wollen, müssen sie erst einmal die Gegenwart überleben.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Sergeant Hicks wurde auf einem privaten Schießplatz erschossen aufgefunden. Fehlende Blutspuren deuten darauf hin, dass er woanders ermordet wurde. Alexx stellt fest, dass Hicks vor seinem Tod Beruhigungs- und Schmerzmittel genommen hat.

programme.title: CSI: Miami

programme.title: CSI: Vegas

Darryl beginnt heftig mit Finn zu flirten. Doch als Finn mitbekommt, dass Darryl vergeben ist, weist sie ihn zurück. Da zückt Darryl ein Messer und bedroht Finn.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas

programme.title: CSI: Vegas

Doch dann tauchen die Handtücher und Materialien auf, mit denen die Wanne gereinigt wurde, und darin findet sich die DNS eines Mitpatienten.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas

programme.desc: Ihre Songs sind Meilensteine, ihre Geschichten spektakulär! SO KLINGT DEUTSCHLAND präsentiert unsere 50 beliebtesten Rock- und Pop-Bands aller Zeiten - ermittelt in Zusammenarbeit mit Media Control.Von ikonischen Legenden bis zu den heutigen Megastars: Ihre Hits lassen einen nicht mehr los. Besonders dann, wenn man ganz neue, spannende Einblicke hinter die Kulissen bekommt. Das lädt ein zum Feiern und Mitsingen, mit großen Emotionen.Promi-Experten wie Entertainer Bernd Stelter, Musikexperte und Moderator Amiaz Habtu, ESC-Kommentator Thorsten Schorn, Rapper Bürger Lars Dietrich, die Sängerinnen Lucy Diakovska und Fernanda Brandão sowie Moderatorin Aleks Bechtel liefern Hintergrundwissen und teilen ihre persönlichen Anekdoten und Insider-Geheimnisse. Besonders Doro Pesch, selbst eine Ikone des deutschen Rock, hat einige der Bands auch privat hautnah erlebt und weiß, was hinter dem Mythos Sex, Drugs And Rock'n'Roll wirklich steckt.Und wer kommt bei den Deutschen am besten an? Wir fragen nach: Haben die Frauen andere Lieblingsbands als die Männer? Feiert der Süden andere Bands als der Osten oder der Westen? Und welche Band landet auf Platz 1?

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report
programme.desc: Eine resolute Frau sperrt einen splitternackten Eindringling in ihr Gartenhaus. Über seine Absichten schweigt der sich allerdings aus. Und: Ein Einbruch bringt die Beamten auf die Spur eines Ehedramas inklusive versuchtem Doppelmord.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report
programme.desc: Ein experimentierfreudiges Paar wird beim Sex im Freien beschossen, kurz danach finden die Beamten einen in einem Netz gefangenen Mann. Und: Die minderjährige Tochter einer Autofahrerin verschwindet spurlos von einer Tankstelle.

programme.title: Veijarikopla Mallorcalla (7)

programme.title: Tommy (16)

Hänen jengissään pyörii Bart, joka haluaa taiteilijaksi sekä Harald, joka myy huumeita. He seurustelevat valokuvaaja-Jonnyn ja tämän tyttöystävän Linnean kanssa. Yhdessä he kokevat iloa ja surua, pohtivat elämää ja matkustavat Gotlantiin polkupyöräilemään.

Vain palvelusväkeen kuuluva Anna pystyy antamaan lämpöä kuolevalle Agnesille. Elokuva sai viisi Oscar-ehdokkuutta ja voitti Oscarin parhaasta kuvauksesta.

programme.desc: Suosikkikomediassa Björn Skifs ja Suzanne Reuter. Kun Göranin perhe on purjehtimassa, hän ostaa puuhuvilan pakkohuutokaupasta ja alkaa tarmokkaasti remontoida sitä. Unelmahökkelissä piilee kuitenkin hengenvaarallinen salaisuus...

programme.title: Rallybrudar (7)
programme.desc: 60-luvun Värmlannissa kaksi naista uhmaa ympäristönsä odotuksia osallistumalla rallikilpailuun. Eläinlääkärin apulainen Ulla rakastaa vauhtia. Suurtalollisen tyttö Birgitta unelmoi Pariisista. Ralliparina molempien unelmat ehkä toteutuvat.

programme.title: Underbara älskade (7)
programme.desc: Lars menetti vaimonsa ja nuorimman poikansa auto-onnettomuudessa yhdeksän kuukautta sitten. Nyt Lars ja hänen toinen poikansa Jonas tuskin puhuvat toisilleen. Lars toivoo pääsevänsä eroon tuhoisasta apatiastaan lähtemällä Jonasin kanssa perheen kesähuvilalle saaristoon.

programme.title: Lasinpuhaltajan lapset (S)
programme.desc: Joen toisella puolella suuressa linnassa asuu Valtiatar Valtiattarensa kanssa. Valtiaan suurin ilo on, kun hän saa totella Valtiatarta. Eräänä päivänä hän toivoo että hänellä olisi lapsia, pieni poika ja pieni tyttö...

programme.title: Klara (S)
programme.desc: Klara muuttaa uuteen kaupunkiin ja hänellä on vaikeuksia löytää uusia kavereita. Uudet luokkakaverit pitävät ratsastuksesta, joten Klarakin lähtee tallille. Pian hän ilmottautuu jo esteratsastuskisaan, vaikka ei osaa vielä edes ratsastaa. Hevospiireissä hän kuitenkin tapaa suloisen Jonte-pojan. Ruotsalainen koko perheen elokuva.

programme.title: Veljeni Leijonamieli
programme.desc: Veljekset Korppu ja Joonatan Leijona tapaavat jälleen lyhyeksi jääneen maanpäällisen elämänsä jälkeen maassa nimeltä Nangijala, jossa vallitsee tarun ja nuotiotulten aikakausi.

programme.title: Comedy Queen (12)
programme.desc: 13-vuotias Sasha on päättänyt, että hänestä tulee stand up -koomikko. Kaikkein eniten hän haluaa saada isänsä nauramaan, sillä tämä usein itkee suihkussa uskoen, ettei kukaan kuule sitä. Kotona kaikki muistuttaa Sashaa edesmenneestä äidistään, mutta vaikka kyyneleet polttelevatkin hänen silmiensä takana, Sasha ei suostu itkemään. Hän laatii salaa listan kaikesta, mitä hänen täytyy tehdä selvitäkseen surusta, kuten ajella tukkansa lyhyeksi, lopettaa kirjojen lukeminen, kieltäytyä maailman söpöimmästä koiranpennusta ja ennen kaikkea tulla komedian kuningattareksi.

programme.title: Polta nämä kirjeet (12)
programme.desc: Tosipohjaiseen kirjaan perustuva ruotsalaisdraama 1930-luvulla eletystä intohimoisesta kolmiodraamasta, jonka jälkikaiut ulottuvat nykypäivään saakka.

programme.title: Arn - Pohjoinen valtakunta (12)
programme.desc: Saagan toisessa osassa Arn jättää Jerusalemin ja palaa kotiinsa tavatakseen rakkaansa Cecilian. He menevät naimisiin ja perustavat perheen, mutta ajat eivät ole suinkaan vakaat -sota uhkaa puhjeta minä hetkenä hyvänsä.

programme.title: Viimeinen sopimus (16)
programme.desc: Ruotsalaistrilleri poliisista, joka värvätään turvallisuuspoliisiin ja saa tutkittavakseen tapauksen, joka koskee suunnitelmaa murhata pääministeri.

programme.title: Besökarna (12)
programme.desc: Perhe on juuri muuttanut unelmataloonsa maalle. Pian alkaa tapahtua outoja. Seinistä kuuluu raapivia ääniä, ovet avautuvat ja sulkeutuvat itsekseen. Ovatko he talossa yksin, vai onko siellä muitakin?

programme.title: Kahakka Benderissä (7)
programme.desc: On vuosi 1713, ja kuningas Kaarle XII on turkkilaiskylä Benderin ulkopuolella. Hän ei luovuta, ja suurvisiiri tekee kaikkensa päästäkseen hänestä eroon.

programme.title: Irralliset (12)
programme.desc: Frank on 30-vuotias, naimisissa oleva asianajaja. Frank ajattelee liikaa seksiä ja liian vähän työtään. Hänestä tuntuu siltä, että hän vain leikkii aikuista ja varoo aina jäävänsä kiinni.

programme.title: Se pikkuinen Lotta
programme.desc: Perustuu Astrid Lindgrenin tarinaan. Pikkuinen, jääräpäinen Lotta herää eräänä aamuna väärällä jalalla. Hän haluaa oppia ajamaan pyörällä ja lähtee hankkimaan itselleen ajopeliä.

programme.title: Päästäkää vangit irti - on kevät! (S)
programme.desc: Tage Danielssonin humoristinen panos vankikeskusteluun sisältää aimo annoksen huumoria, iloa ja lämpöä.

programme.title: Enkelten talo - toinen kesä (7)
programme.desc: Uusi, mullistava kesä alkaa, kun Fanny ja Zac palaavat Enkelten taloon. Riidat ja kaksinaismoraali ovat tallella yhtä terävinä kuin ennenkin. Paljastuu että Gottfridillä ja Ivarilla on veli Sven, joka muutti Amerikkaan lapsena. Heidän etsimisestään ei ole koskaan ollut puhetta. Hänhän asuu Amerikassa - ja Gottfrid ja Ivar eivät ole käyneet edes Göteborgissa. He eivät kuitenkaan mahda Fannyn suostuttelulle mitään ja löytävät itsensä New Yorkista.
